measurement_limits: RLIMIT_CPU=(4,4) is per process; kernel accounting and termination have granularity.
Darwin RLIMIT_RSS is advisory; external process-group RSS is sampled, not an exact allocation cap.
Solver watchdog targets 50ms polling and triggers at 1.9s; OS scheduling can overshoot. Record observations and violations, never claim an exact 2s hard guarantee.
Batch CPU includes supervisor absolute RUSAGE_SELF and all RUSAGE_CHILDREN including ps/memory_pressure, plus frozen scan charge. Live worker CPU is separately observed until wait4 reaps it.
The final receipt measures through its accounting point; a conservative 0.1s charge covers the unmeasured serialization/exit tail but is not an independently measured hard bound.
